# commander_contact (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Keeper `contact` record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a contact record by title or UID.
data "commander_contact" "example" {
  contact = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_TITLE_OR_UID_"
}

output "contact_id" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.id
}

output "contact_title" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.title
}

output "contact_notes" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.notes
}

output "contact_folder" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.folder
}

output "contact_name" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.name
}

output "contact_name_first" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.name.first
}

output "contact_name_middle" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.name.middle
}

output "contact_name_last" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.name.last
}

output "contact_company" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.company
}

output "contact_email" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.email
}

output "contact_phone" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.phone
}

output "contact_address_ref" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.address_ref
}

output "contact_custom" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.custom
}

output "contact_share" {
  value = data.commander_contact.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contact` (String) Contact record **title** or **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `address_ref` (String) UID of an `address` record linked via `addressRef`.
- `company` (String) Company name.
- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields on the record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `folder` (String) Folder path or UID where the record is stored.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (**UID**) of the contact record.
- `name` (Attributes) Person name (`name` field): first, middle, last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name))
- `notes` (String) Notes on the record.
- `phone` (Attributes List) Phone numbers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone))
- `share` (Attributes Map) Users with share permissions on this record (keyed by email). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `title` (String) Record title.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value is sensitive.
- `type` (String) Keeper field type.
- `value` (String) Field value.


<a id="nestedatt--name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name`

Read-Only:

- `first` (String) First name.
- `last` (String) Last name.
- `middle` (String) Middle name.


<a id="nestedatt--phone"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone`

Read-Only:

- `ext` (String) Extension.
- `number` (String) Phone number.
- `region` (String) Region or country code.
- `type` (String) Phone type: `Mobile`, `Home`, or `Work`.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Whether the user can edit this record.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Whether the user can share this record.
